edits.new: If a proposed counterexample violates a child requirement, test whether satisfying that requirement can preserve its exclusion from every parent alternative and permitted topic connection. Evaluate that corrected case against the whole child meaning. Reject it only by identifying the child wording or necessary implication that makes it inadmissible; a familiar association or a failed incomplete candidate does not establish full coverage.
edits.old: To reject a variation as inadmissible, identify the child's wording or necessary implication that it contradicts. Explain that contradiction. A familiar association or an assertion that something "necessarily" fits is insufficient.
